title: ACR MCP source_evidence Request v1
description: Input for the source_evidence tool. Pass exactly one of (the schema stays free of a top-level oneOf/anyOf/conditional because some model APIs refuse them; the tool refuses neither, both, or an empty list with a validation error) evidence_ref_id (one reference) or evidence_ref_ids (up to 10 references of the same answer, expanded in one call). result_id is required for a Context Fabric reference (acr:v1:...), which is keyed by its subject and expands only in the scope of the answer that returned it; in a batch it applies to every reference. A pull-request or work-item reference names one row and needs no result_id. Each reference is authorized on its own: a refused or unknown reference is its own refused entry in the response, never a failed call.

evidence_ref_id.description: An evidence reference exactly as a previous context_for_task or investigate_question (if listed) response returned it (its evidence_ref_ids, or an evidence reference on a context item). Opaque: pass it back unchanged; never build or parse one yourself.

evidence_ref_ids.description: Up to 10 evidence references exactly as previous tool responses returned them, all from the same answer (one result_id). The response carries one entry per reference, in this order. Opaque: pass them back unchanged. Use instead of evidence_ref_id.

result_id.description: The result_id of the investigate_question (if listed) answer that returned evidence_ref_id. Required when evidence_ref_id is a Context Fabric reference (acr:v1:...): the reference names its subject, not its answer, so without the result_id the citation of a different result could be returned. Opaque: pass it back unchanged.
